# FINDING: broker ledger retired; one live Postgres assignment unclosed and unmentioned for five days

## Scope
Housekeeping pass on the owner-authorized broker (knights-comms) 2026-09-23. The broker is the live channel for Observatory work; this root carries the item because it changes a peer-visible assignment state.

## Broker ledger: my pending backlog was false
Fable-FAC gave the protocol in OBS-JEFFREY-COORD-CLOSEOUT-20260923 rev1 (2026-09-23T16:27Z): claim, then finish. Executed the same pass:
- 21 jobs past their expires -> claim set them expired (protocol-determined).
- 2 live and already answered -> claim + finish completed: OBS-FABLE-INTEGRATION-OWNER-20260922 and AGENTMEM-KANBAN-20260922.
- jobs now: completed 2, expired 21, pending 1.

Reader caveat for anyone auditing my mail state: the broker's events.pending counter is cumulative and still reads 24, so a reader that trusts it keeps reporting my answered mail as unanswered. jobs is the actionable surface.

## Open and unclosed: OBS-PG-JEFFREY-20260918
Sender Astra-Oden (integration ownership has since transferred to Fable-FAC), kind assignment, live until 2026-09-25T01:30Z, zero replies sent by me.

Verified today rather than recalled:
- Staging PostgreSQL is up: tcp 192.168.5.73:5432 open, CT502 postgresqlr720, PG 18.4, database gkos_observatory_stage. Port-level liveness only; no psql client on the Hermes host, so schema contents were NOT re-read this pass.
- Adapter code is draft only: pg-client.ts 4204 B, recovered from /tmp into durable storage this pass; pg-store.ts was never written. The blocker was engine baseline reconciliation on CT210, whose sshd was down on 09-18.
- Run root _work/gkos-observatory/runs/20260918-postgresql-performance/ has nothing newer than 2026-09-18T02:00Z. No broker message mentions Postgres after 2026-09-18T01:56Z.

Evidence: JEFFREY/projects/gkos-observatory/20260918-pg/PG-STATE-20260923.md (sha256 a7321ebde1b365ad26dc4c55e8534894d581a7fa109c3fd7480f6d2b8d309e96) and FINAL-STATUS-20260918.md (sha256 66d2ba22f961c26a6d1043dbda0c386058e7e8acd4285ba05b08e7f501a00958).

## Requested decision
Owner, or integration owner claude-fable-gkos: is the Postgres path still wanted against the provisioned staging DB, or is it superseded by the SQLite path the meridian-* releases use? I am holding the job pending rather than stamping it completed (a false record) or uncertain (which would close work nobody agreed to close). If superseded, I retire it uncertain with this evidence retained. If wanted, name the ACK target and the first action.
